header.name: Village Library [v055]
header.description: v055: grading added to the building menu: clears 40x40x40 to air with a dirt/stone floor, and collects ores, logs and other traded goods into a nearby chest. v054: the greenhouse's two dispensers beside the bee nests now come with shears inside, copied from the source world (extras structures). v053: the counter (iron block or waxed sign) is now the building core: detected after placement, recorded on the building record, and tapping it shows what the building produces (display-only mock). v052: brush undo refuses mines and ports (use the mace). v051: brush undo now dries the whole area first, same as the mace. v050: mace demolish first dries the whole area (removes all waterlogging and water, twice) before clearing. v049: sugar cane is placed last (no more cane in chests); mace demolish clears waterlogged water in every cell via slab+setWaterlogged(false). v048: greenhouse waterlogged cells now rotate with the building (v047 placed them unrotated, flooding wrong spots); mace demolish also sweeps leftover liquid. v047: wet cells now rotate with the building; mace demolish also sweeps leftover liquid; mace demolish now clears leftover waterlogged water (fill air per layer). greenhouse water now matches the source world (96 waterlogged channel stairs/slabs restored; the flowing channel is placed last so it no longer spills). v046: mace now clears the building area to bare ground (brush undo still restores the recorded terrain); stray waterlogging is cleared after placement. v045: mace destroy and undo now remove falling/attached blocks (anvils, torches, doors) top-down first, clear waterlogging, and sweep dropped items; the greenhouse entrance steps stay dry. v044: trapdoors now follow building rotation (trapdoor direction uses east/west/south/north order), and greenhouse sugar cane gets its water (adjacent stairs/slabs are waterlogged before the cane is placed). v043: greenhouse re-registered from the v4 export (lantern positions fixed, cherry leaves/wood removed, bee colony now in the other nest). v042: builds now run on real progress (gauge + %) instead of a fixed 5s countdown, and support-hungry blocks (sugar cane, bamboo, lanterns, wall signs, doors) are placed in a second pass after the main body. A library of village facilities. Place a bone block, hold paper and interact to pick a village (or My Creations) and build its facilities. v034: the cleanup sweep now also checks actual player positions before clearing a plot (occupied plots are skipped and retried at the end), and removes leftover mobs/drops like a normal box annihilation. v015: build the Mine to link it to an underground elevator room in a separate dimension.
